! Game text
| If you just deployed or moved a second {{Errata hl|1=piloted}} Rebel starfighter to a system, you {{Errata hl|1=may immediately deploy one Nebulon-B Frigate or Mon Calamari ship}} there from under your Starting Effect and place this card on that ship. Ship is power and hyperspeed +2 and immune to attrition &lt; 5. {{Errata hl|1=Lose Immediate Effect to make an additional regular move}} with this ship. (Immune to Control.) || If you just deployed or moved a second Rebel starfighter to a system, {{Errata hl|1=deploy a [Death Star II] starship}} there from under your Starting Effect; deploy on that starship: it is power and hyperspeed +2 and immune to attrition &lt; 5. {{Errata hl|1=Once per game this starship may make an additional move.}} (Immune to Control.)
